what_it_does: Modern AI chips stack multiple chiplets (small chip tiles glued together in 3D) and run at high power density, creating thermal hotspots and voltage fluctuations. This paper presents a tiny sensor that measures both temperature and power supply voltage simultaneously on a single chip, fusing the two measurements to predict thermal and power problems accurately. The sensor works without external reference equipment and keeps working reliably as voltage scales down and noise creeps in—important for chips that need to operate at thousands of different power and temperature conditions across their silicon.
